_doc: Portraits shown at the top of a person's card (added 2026-11-13, Michiko). Each entry: 'id' and 'name' of the person record (build_viewer.py stops if the id is gone or its name no longer matches, so a merge or re-numbering cannot silently put a face on the wrong person), 'thumb' (small image in portraits/, about 440px wide, picture only), 'full' (the larger crop with its printed caption, in clippings/; opens when the thumbnail is clicked), 'caption' and 'credit' (shown under the picture). To add a portrait: save both images, add an entry, rebuild.
